spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Going, going to, attaining, obtaining.
2 Abandoning, leaving.
E.
हा to go, शानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The destruction of the world: see जहानक.

f. (-र्षा)
Wish to take or seize.
E.
हृ to take, desiderative form, चङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु)
Wishing to take, seizing, carrying off.
E.
हृ to take, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं)
1

Crooked.
2

Dishonest.
3

Slow, lazy.
m. (-ह्मः)
A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)
E.
हा to quit, (a straight line,) मन् Uṇādi affix, and the root reduplicated, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going tortuously or lazily.
m. (-गः)
A snake.
E.
जिह्म as above, and ग what goes.

f. (-ता)
1 Crookedness, curvature.
2 Dishonesty.
E.
तल added to जिह्म; also with त्व, जिह्मत्वं.

m. (-नः)
A frog.
E.
जिह्म slowly, and मोहन copulation.

m. (-ल्यः)
The Khadira, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
जिह्म crooked, शल्य a dart.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bent, bowed, curved.
2 Turned away.
E.
जिह्म, and इतच् aff.

mf. (-हूः-ह्वा)
The tongue.
E.
लिह to lick, Uṇādi affix वन्, and the initial changed to ज.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Greedy.
E.
जिहू the tongue, ल to take, क affix, deriv. irr.

n. (-ग्रं)
The tip of the tongue.
E.
जिह्वा, and अग्र end.

n. (-नं)
1 Scraping the tongue.
2 A tongue-scraper.
E.
जिह्वा, and निर्लेखन scraping.

m. (-पः)
1 A dog.
2 A cat.
3 A tiger.
4 The hunting leopard.
5 A bear.
E.
जिह्वा the tongue, and प who drinks, who laps.

n. (-लं)
The fur of the tongue.
E.
जिह्वा, and मल dirt, excretion.

n. (-लं)
The root of the tongue.
E.
जिह्वा, and मूल a root.

m. (-यः)
A character substituted for the Visarga, as हरिन्काम्य, and with a like sound.
E.
जिह्वामूल, and छ aff.

m. (-दः)
A bird.
E.
जिह्वा, and रद a tooth; whose tooth, (i. e. beak,) is like a tongue.

m. (-लिट्)
A dog.
E.
जिह्वा, and लिह् who licks or laps, from लिह with क्विप् aff.

m. (-दः)
Licking, lapping.
E.
जिह्वा the tongue, and आस्वाद eating.

n. (-तं)
A hundred tongues.
E.
जिह्वा, and शत a century.

n. (-नं)
Scraping the tongue.
f. (-नी)
A tongue-scraper, made of a thin piece of wood of the Mimusops Kauki or other trees.
E.
जिह्वा, and उल्लेखन scraping; also in the second sense, with कन् added, जिह्वोल्लेखनिका.
